entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy., Home Deptt., Lucknow And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Prashant Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ajay Kumar Pandey
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
A counter affidavit has been filed today in Court by the State, which is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.
3. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.90 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Baba Bazar, District Ayodhya.
Rahul Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.

entities.text: Rahul Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report.

Subsequently, in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she was in love with the applicant and she had gone out of her own freewill and had also married to the applicant.
The age of the victim is disclosed as 17 years.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 28.08.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Rahul Yadav be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024 akverma  Rahul Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy., ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31323697/
